items.title: Nepali Congress to provide warm clothes and mental health counselling to flood-hit communities
items.summary: Kathmandu, November 6 The Nepali Congress has decided to launch a campaign to distribute warm clothes and provide mental health counselling to people affected by the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli floods and landslides in Rasuwa, Dhading and Nuwakot districts.
